notes: The apodosis *that* is placed on הָיָה under rule 45, since the apodosis verb תִּמְחֶה carries no waw of its own; the unit is discontinuous across the whole temporal clause (rule 25).
מִסָּבִיב follows rule 40's reading, which gives *round about* whole to the adverb and leaves the preposition `unrepresented`.
